observations: Photo 0 and Photo 1 show the same electronic keyboard wrapped in clear plastic.
The keyboard has 61 keys (37 white, 24 black), typical of a standard 51-key entry-level model.
The front panel includes a central display screen, a large rotary dial, and multiple buttons and sliders.
The keyboard appears to be in a used condition, with visible wear on the plastic wrap and some minor scuffs on the casing.
The background shows a tiled floor and a doorway, suggesting an outdoor or semi-outdoor setting.
No power cord, stand, or accessories are visible in the photos.

claims.claim: Quality London used keyboard with super sounds
claims.evidence: The brand 'London' is not visible in the photos. The keyboard appears used, but 'super sounds' is subjective and not verifiable from the images.

risks.risk: The keyboard may not be functional or may have internal damage not visible in photos.
risks.proof: A video showing the keyboard powered on, keys responding, and sound output.

risks.risk: The keyboard may be missing accessories such as power adapter, stand, or sustain pedal.
risks.proof: Photo showing all included accessories laid out next to the keyboard.

risks.risk: The keyboard may have hidden physical damage or wear not visible under plastic wrap.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the casing, keys, and internal components (if possible) without plastic wrap.
risks.if_unproven: priced as having potential hidden damage

proof_requests: Video of the keyboard powered on and playing sounds.
Photo showing all included accessories (power adapter, stand, etc.).
Close-up photos of the keyboard without plastic wrap, showing keys, casing, and any damage.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
